An estimated 263 million women and girls aged 15 years and older, or 8% globally, have been subjected to sexual violence from a man other than an intimate partner at least once since the age of 15 years. clinical_trials.title: Gut Viruses May Warn of Deadly Intestinal Disease in Preemies Up to Eight Days Early - trialsitenews.com

The findings support mind-body therapies as potentially useful supportive care—but they did not substantially reduce pain intensity, an important distinction between feeling less pain and functioning better despite it.
